Jwt.//: Signing key lives in user-secrets (dev) or the Jwt__Key env var (prod) — never here.
Jwt.//expiry: A token lasts ExpiryMinutes and is renewed while the user is active (after RefreshAfterMinutes), so ExpiryMinutes is also the idle timeout. MaxSessionHours caps a whole session.
